label: boot-001 capture failure
observed_error: Fatal error. Internal CLR error. (0x80131506), System.Buffer.MemmoveInternal, System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.Copy
diagnosis: The returned byte array is 4 bytes longer than 1024*768*2. The initial native copy incorrectly used the whole array length instead of the bitmap buffer bound.
corrective_plan: Preserve the original data and failing script. Use a bounded managed conversion of exactly width*height*2 RGB565 bytes; retain and record any extra trailing bytes. Inspect the result before GUI actuation.
